description: This file contains conversion functions for Kubernetes flowcontrol v1beta3 PriorityLevelConfiguration objects, including functions to convert to and from internal representations, and utility functions for managing annotations related to NominalConcurrencyShares.

methods.name: dropPriorityLevelConcurrencyShareDefaultAnnotation
methods.description: Removes the PriorityLevelPreserveZeroConcurrencySharesKey annotation from the input map if present.

methods.name: addPriorityLevelConcurrencyShareDefaultAnnotation
methods.description: Adds the PriorityLevelPreserveZeroConcurrencySharesKey annotation to the input map if not already present.

methods.name: copyStringMap
methods.description: Creates a copy of the provided map of strings.
